**Explanation:** The question asks us to determine the truth value of the third statement given the first two. From statement 1 (Oranges > Apples) and statement 2 (Bananas > Oranges), we can deduce the chain Bananas > Oranges > Apples. Therefore, both parts of statement 3 are true: Bananas cost more than apples (by transitivity) and bananas cost more than oranges (directly from statement 2). Assistant A incorrectly claims the statement is false, while Assistant B correctly identifies it as true and provides clear step-by-step reasoning showing how both components of the compound statement are satisfied.

[[B]]
